pathAssistantSteps.info:
A prospect you are working. Most New Business is self-sourced by Sales; some arrives via events, data leads, form completions or direct enquiry.

  • A named contact has engaged - reply, call or meeting
  • There is a real need to explore
  • A next step is agreed and dated

Qualify next - do not skip it. Expert Insight (Panoramic, In-Depth, GXRs): add the product(s) before you advance.

Qualification gate - do not skip. Our deals are lost to budget, engagement and ROI, rarely to competitors - so prove these now (P-E-B-D-C):

  • Pain - a problem our product solves
  • Economic buyer identified and aware
  • Budget confirmed (our number-one loss reason)
  • Decision process and date understood
  • Champion engaged - keep both sides active

If any are missing, stay here or disqualify.

Customer is actively assessing us. Advance when:

  • Success criteria agreed and you have shown ROI (lack of ROI and weak engagement are top loss reasons)
  • Proposal or quote shared and acknowledged
  • A mutual close date is set

Stall warning: 40% of deals stall here. No agreed next date means it is slipping - keep engaging; silence on our side loses deals.

Yes, subject to terms. Only deals where the customer has committed belong here.

  • Customer gave verbal or written commitment to proceed
  • Price and terms being finalised
  • Moving to paper (redlines or order process underway)

Still proving value? That is Evaluate.

Paperwork is with the customer to sign.

  • Issue the contract or order to the customer for signature (or send the CPQ quote document)
  • Contract Attached is set automatically once a contract file or a sent/signed quote document is on the opportunity - you do not tick it
  • Commercial terms agreed

This stage is for deals out for signature, not deals you intend to send.

Customer signed - Finance approving. Not won yet (still open).

  • Your job: make sure the signed contract is on the opportunity (the system then sets Contract Attached)
  • The rest is checked automatically - Ultimate Account, Lead Source, Contact Role, Sales Handshake, open Success-Plan tasks. If anything is missing, the save tells you exactly what
  • Top ID / Group ID applies to ALM Subscriptions and Intelligence Services only

Auto-submits to Finance; flips to Closed Won on approval. You do not set Closed Won yourself.
Set by Finance approval - revenue booked. The deal is won once the Pending Approval stage is approved by Finance.

Record the loss - every team, no exceptions. Pick the real reason - most are Budget, Client or LBR engagement, Buyer issues, No-fault, or Lack of ROI.

  • Primary Reason
  • Sub-reason
  • A one-line Note

Competitor losses are rare - if you tick one, be sure. This is how we fix what loses us deals.
